overview: Marketing managers decide how a company finds and keeps customers. They study markets and competitors, set prices and campaigns, plan budgets and lead teams of marketers, designers and analysts. O*NET rates their enterprising interest at a maximum 7.00 and knowledge of sales and marketing at 4.71 out of 5. Most hold a bachelor's degree in marketing or business and work up from specialist roles. The BLS May 2025 median is $166,790 across 395,240 jobs. Expect long weeks at a desk, regular meetings and tight deadlines around launches.
pay: Marketing managers earn a median of $166,790, and the top 10% earn $293,610 or more. Massachusetts has the highest state median at $212,020, 27% above the national figure. California and New York have the most jobs, 54,660 and 54,000, at medians of $193,620 and $181,200.

faq.q: How much do marketing managers make?
faq.a: The BLS May 2025 median is $166,790 a year. The middle half earn between $123,020 and $216,410, and the lowest 10% earn under $90,260. Massachusetts, California and Virginia ($187,820) pay the most, while Mississippi and West Virginia have the lowest state medians.

faq.q: How do you become a marketing manager?
faq.a: Most start with a bachelor's degree in marketing, business or communications, then spend several years as a marketing specialist or analyst. O*NET places the job in Job Zone 4. There are 9 related majors, including marketing management and pharmaceutical marketing.

faq.q: What skills do marketing managers need?
faq.a: O*NET rates active listening at 4.12 out of 5 for this job and speaking at 4. Knowledge of customer service is rated 4.33 and communications and media 4.09. Adaptability stands out, since tactics change fast with new channels and customer data.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to marketing manager?
faq.a: The closest moves are Purchasing Managers (85% match), Financial Managers (80%) and Compensation and Benefits Managers (79%), based on O*NET 31.0. Chief Executives are a 77% match and earn $213,990, 28% more, according to BLS May 2025 data.
